rv.q: Faithful readers will note that I’ve been doling out positive reviews left and right these days. That speaks to the general high quality of Broadway as of late; I cannot recall the last production I saw that wasn’t at least decent.
Youth isn't only for the young, at least not as a marketable commodity in popular entertainment.
13 is a show that knows exactly what it wants to be and exactly how to be it, even if what it wants to be isn't necessarily groundbreaking or sophisticated.
Wright furiously tears around as the flamboyant Jacques.

cn.t: Critics praise "13" for delivering an energetic, high-quality Broadway experience, with reviewers celebrating its youthful exuberance and the show's ability to capture genuine theatrical excitement.

vs.sum: The Bernard B. Jacobs Theatre offers excellent sightlines from most seats, though comfort is compromised by tight legroom, especially in the mezzanine. The theater's ambiance is enhanced by its historic architecture and unique murals, but restroom facilities are limited, leading to long lines during intermission.

acc.note: 7 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Copper induction loop available.
